findings.summary: The right-triangle formulas used shortened Arabic side labels instead of the established الضلع المقابل and الضلع المجاور terms.
evidence: The explanatory text used الضلع المقابل and الضلع المجاور while the formulas displayed only المقابل and المجاور.
findings.resolution: Expanded all three visible formulas to the established Arabic side terminology.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas used shortened Arabic side labels that differed from the surrounding explanation.
evidence: The formulas used المقابل and المجاور while the section explained the terms as الضلع المقابل and الضلع المجاور.
findings.resolution: Aligned all three inverse formulas with the established Arabic side terminology.

findings.summary: The worked trigonometry example used abbreviated side labels instead of the terms used in the Arabic explanation.
evidence: The example labels were المقابل and المجاور while the surrounding text used الضلع المقابل and الضلع المجاور.
findings.resolution: Expanded both example labels to الضلع المقابل and الضلع المجاور.
